scope: Existing paid funding continuation observes actual Ethereum finality and supports Pause without a fixed120-second failure.
reviewed: Only wallet-session implementation and existing tests changed. No payment, claim, proof or receipt-finality requirement is removed.

Subscription is installed before immediate finalized read; completion depends on native finalized block number, never elapsed time. Native installed ethers PollingBlockTagSubscriber emits numeric finalized block numbers; on/off APIs are supported.
Run-owned AbortController aborts pending finality observation; initial in-flight read is drained, listener and abort handler removed in finally, account ownership retained until cleanup.
Pause before/during registration is checked, and the existing context/pause fence runs after observation before message readiness or submission.
Failed reads propagate with cleanup; saved payment and exact attempted claim reconciliation remain unchanged.
limitations: Focused tests include labelled component doubles and virtual clock advancement; no real proof/payment was replayed.
The existing paid MetaMask operation must resume after affected assets are deployed; no new payment is authorized by this review.
SDK-owned observation may continue pending while network finality is pending; Pause remains available.
